Scope: Added testRequesterUsername/Email/UserId/AccessToken. Root cause of a repeat-run failure the author hit: Folder 6's orders A-G all used the shared, long-lived 'alice' seed account as requester, whose credit wallet accumulates escrow drift across every run of this suite (and any other manual testing against it) rather than starting fresh each time; after enough accumulated runs her available balance dropped low enough that later orders in the sequence (D, F, G) failed credit reservation and resolved to REJECTED instead of OPEN, cascading into every downstream assertion for those orders. Fix: Folder 6 now registers and logs in a brand-new throwaway requester (mirroring the existing courierA/courierB pattern, so it always starts with the standard fresh-registration credit grant) and uses it as the requester for every order in the folder instead of alice; alice is no longer touched by Folder 6 at all.
